sourceSteps: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续抬高杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。

reviewObservations.start: Upright feet planted, both arms nearly straight down with upper arms beside ribs. One rigid straight bar with two plates held in shoulder-width underhand grasp below waist.
reviewObservations.end: Same camera, feet, torso, bar and plate dimensions. Both elbows flexed with upper arms down beside ribs, rigid bar at upper chest below chin, underhand grip retained.
